s.zh: 士兵背景（3格内有士兵战友）
- 殖民地有罪犯背景的殖民者:
s.en: - colony has colonists with a criminal background:

s.zh: 侍僧、罪犯、民间英雄、贵族、贤者、士兵、隐士、局外人 8 个背景特性进入原版特性随机池，一个人最多一个背景。关闭后不再生成新的背景特性，已有的保留。立即生效。
s.en: Eight background traits (acolyte, criminal, folk hero, noble, sage, soldier, hermit, outlander) join the vanilla random trait pool, at most one background per person. When off, no new background traits are generated; existing ones are kept. Takes effect immediately.

s.zh: %（每个背景的出现权重 = 0.3 × 此值）
